product_launches.description: Claim Health introduced its AI-powered revenue infrastructure platform for post-acute care providers, automating referral-to-reimbursement workflows such as intake, eligibility verification, authorization management, and payment reconciliation.

overview_description.description: Claim Health is a developer of an agentic AI platform for revenue cycle management in home health, hospice, and post-acute care organizations. The platform automates referral intake, eligibility verification, prior authorizations, billing operations, denial management, payment reconciliation, and revenue assurance workflows. Claim Health uses AI-powered automation and digital workers to reduce manual administrative tasks, identify revenue risks before claims are submitted, and improve visibility into financial performance.

about_short_description.short_description: Claim Health is a AI revenue platform that is fully automated through AI billing for healthcare industry.

product.name: Claim Health AI Revenue Platform
product.description: An AI-enabled platform for automating revenue operations across post-acute care, from referral intake and coverage checks through authorization, billing, payment reconciliation, and cash resolution.

product.name: Billing Operations
product.description: A revenue-cycle automation service that supports payment posting, claim and payment reconciliation, denial handling, appeals, and prioritized follow-up through cash resolution.

product.name: Smart Intake
product.description: An automated referral-intake workflow that consolidates fax, email, and portal referrals, extracts patient and coverage data, verifies eligibility, and routes qualified cases for admission.

product.name: Authorization Autopilot
product.description: An authorization-management service that automates prior-authorization submission, documentation checks, approval tracking, renewal monitoring, and exception alerts.

product.name: Revenue Assurance
product.description: A pre-billing revenue-risk monitoring service that reviews EMR data for eligibility, documentation, and coverage issues before claims are submitted.

product.name: Platform Intelligence
product.description: A real-time revenue-operations visibility and reporting capability for monitoring intake, authorization, billing, cash performance, revenue risk, and automation impact.
